messages:
Monica Patel: Heads up — we’re rolling out a 2025 Benefits & Perks refresh. Main items: wellness stipend increase, new mental health sessions, and expanded parental leave. Details here: confluence://company-handbook/03_benefits-and-perks/benefits-perks-update-2025

Avery Johnson: Nice — when does the wellness stipend change kick in?

Monica Patel: Effective 2025-02-01. Same reimbursement flow, higher annual cap.

Hannah Schmitt: Is the mental health benefit through the same portal or separate?

Evelyn Hart: Same portal. It will show as "EAP sessions" once enabled.

Naomi Feldman: If anyone is planning parental leave around March 1, email People Ops and we’ll confirm how the updated weeks apply.

Avery Johnson: :thumbsup:
